title: Longest Happy Prefix
description: Find the longest prefix of a string that is also a suffix (excluding the full string itself) using KMP failure function.
pseudocode:
1: lps = new Array(n).fill(0)
2: j = 0
3: for i from 1 to n-1:
4:   while j > 0 and s[i] != s[j]: j = lps[j-1]
5:   if s[i] == s[j]: j++
6:   lps[i] = j
7: return s.substring(0, j)

steps.note: Initialize LPS table with zeros for string 'level'.
Start loop at index i=1 ('e'). s[1] != s[0] ('e' != 'l').
Move to index i=2 ('v'). s[2] != s[0] ('v' != 'l').
Move to index i=3 ('e'). s[3] != s[0] ('e' != 'l').
Move to index i=4 ('l'). s[4] == s[0] ('l' == 'l'). Increment j.
